changelog: Fixed the separate app installing only the 55 MB Ubuntu rootfs: AntiGem+ now installs the full ~350 MB Termux bootstrap with agy and all agent binaries, exactly like the original app
Fixed 'agy is not installed at /root/.local/bin/agy': the app now recognizes its own package as a termux-style environment and uses the correct agy/bridge/claude binary paths

Fixed 'CANNOT LINK EXECUTABLE' and 'Permission denied' under the com.antigemplus package: hardcoded com.termux paths in the rootfs are rewritten at install time (730+ scripts, 400+ symlinks), and every process spawn gets the correct library path and termux-exec prefix
termux-api commands (toast, vibrate, torch...) now target this app's own receiver instead of the original AntiGem
